question: What was the ranking position (c4) and time taken (c6) for the world championships held in Paris, France during 2003?
sql:
SELECT w.c4 AS ranking_position, w.c6 AS time_taken 
FROM w 
JOIN t_c3_address ON w.id = t_c3_address.m_id 
WHERE w.c2 = 'world championships' AND w.c1_number = 2003 AND t_c3_address.c3_address = 'paris';
